title: Online experts: pure differential privacy for the entire action sequence
summary: After incurring the selected expert's loss, the learner observes the full loss vector; the entire loss stream is fixed in advance. Privacy protects one round's complete loss vector, and the released object is the full action sequence. All causal randomized strategies satisfying the specified privacy condition are allowed.

metric.base_expression: $$R_T=\sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(I_t)-\min_{i\in[K]}\sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(i),\qquad L_\star=\min_{i\in[K]}\sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(i).$$ This is cumulative external regret, not divided by $T$. Privacy separately constrains the specified released record.
metric.normalization: Use the cumulative quantity over T rounds without dividing by T. Preserve the displayed order of probability or expectation.
metric.finiteness_conditions: Both cumulative losses lie in [0,T], so their difference on each execution path lies in [-T,T].
description_paragraphs: Performance is expected cumulative external regret, with $R_T=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ell_t(I_t)-\min_{i\in[K]}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ell_t(i)$. The worst case ranges over fixed loss streams; expectation is over algorithmic randomness.

output.feasibility: The output is the complete action trajectory satisfying feasibility and timing requirements. Randomized mixtures may be implemented before acting. Retrospective averages or convex combinations cannot replace actions that have already incurred loss. No additional optimal value or certificate is required.
output.allowed_postprocessing: Previously executed online actions cannot be changed.
output.certificate_requirement: No function value, optimality certificate, or final recommendation is required unless explicitly listed for this axis.
description_paragraphs: The released record is the entire action sequence $I_{1:T}$. Neighboring input streams differ in one complete loss vector. Past actions cannot be changed by terminal postprocessing.
